--- create_queue_ttl.sql
CREATE QUEUE Q (id INT64, Payload BYTES(MAX) NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (id), ROW DELETION POLICY (OLDER_THAN(DeliverTime, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
